# OGIMORA

> Free online generators of sheet-steel projects. You set up a design in the browser and download a DXF file ready for CNC laser or plasma cutting. Two generators: a steel fire pit and a steel cube for welding practice. Test version, made by one person (OGI).

- Home page: [English](https://ogimora.com/en/) · [Polish](https://ogimora.com/pl/)

## Fire pit generator

- [English](https://ogimora.com/en/firepit/) · [Polish](https://ogimora.com/pl/firepit/)
- What it does: set the base size, height, wall angle and sheet thickness (3, 4 or 5 mm; in inch mode US sheet: 11 ga, 10 ga, 3/16" or 1/4"); choose a cut-out pattern for each of the four walls; add your own lettering; choose holes in the floor. Parts (4 walls + floor) join with tabs and slots.
- Downloads: DXF at 1:1 scale in millimetres or inches; a paper model (PDF, A4 or US Letter); test plates (DXF + PDF instructions) for finding the right slot clearance on a given laser or plasma machine.
- Licence: free for personal use; commercial use up to 20 finished fire pits per design; the files themselves may not be sold or passed on.
- Safety: a fire pit means open fire; cut-out patterns let sparks through.

## Welding cube generator

- [English](https://ogimora.com/en/cube/) · [Polish](https://ogimora.com/pl/cube/)
- What it is: a cube made of six sheet-steel sides that you weld yourself – practice for outside corner welds that leaves you with a dice, a lantern or a garden piece.
- What you set: side length 10–70 cm (4–28 in); sheet from 2 mm (14 ga); on each side dots (dice), numbers, your own lettering (up to three lines, six stencil-friendly fonts) or a large opening; corners cut off into triangles, from tiny to half of the edge.
- Joint: the sides meet at their inner edges (open corner joint), which leaves a groove for the weld on the outside. Locating tabs hold the sides while you tack; tab width and layout are adjustable, separately for cube edges and for corner triangles.
- Downloads: DXF at 1:1 scale in millimetres or inches; a paper model (PDF) to cut from cardboard first.
- Licence: free, also for selling finished cubes; the files themselves may not be sold or passed on.

## Common to both

- Price: free. The site shows a rough cutting-cost estimate for Poland (PLN) and the USA (USD).
- Warranty: none. Files are generated by a script and should be checked before cutting.
- Units: millimetres or inches – a mm / in switch in the top bar.
- Privacy: no cookies, no accounts; anonymous counters only.
- Contact: info@ogimora.com
